intent.proves: No active grid row lacks a container (such rows never render in the layout).
intent.scope: active, non-deleted grid rows that are not presets; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(GridRowId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' page ' + CAST(GridRowPageId AS nvarchar(20)) FROM GridRow WHERE GridRowActive = 1 AND GridRowDeleted = 0 AND ISNULL(GridRowIsTemplate, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(GridRowContainer, N'') = N''
